edits.new: Atlas Gen2 Dedicated clusters on AWS or Google Cloud have a size-dependent baseline IOPS: 3,000 under 1,000 GB, then scaling at 3:1 IOPS per GB above that (for example 6,000 IOPS at 2,000 GB). A flat 3,000-IOPS provider baseline (AWS gp3, Google Hyperdisk Balanced) should not be substituted for this when estimating Gen2 costs, because above 1,000 GB the Atlas included baseline is higher.
